authority_basis.user_standing_authority: The user authorized autonomous scientific iteration and scientific-scope changes while evidence improves within a perception-only learned JEPA for held-out-maze navigation, directed inspection and use of the main training pool, and directed continuation without repeated authorization commands.

frozen_science.architecture: unchanged four-atom recursively integrated local-increment trajectory JEPA with dense three-frame history and ordered action prefixes
frozen_science.target: fixed N320 successive innovations and fixed N320 cumulative future normalized patch latents
frozen_science.joint_training: online encoder history action mode and predictor modules in one optimizer and one backward with fixed target
frozen_science.prediction_loss: raw 0.5 local proper energy score plus raw 0.5 cumulative proper energy score; each domain is 0.5 joint plus 0.5 mean marginal
frozen_science.control_loss: same mixed score with detached target-only mixed persistence denominator; cyclic-action margin 0.05 and ordered-history margin 0.03
frozen_science.normalization: every row contributes; denominator clamp at 1e-6; no low-motion mask or filter
frozen_science.absent_training_terms: centroid squared error + learned target compressor + best_of_K + learned scale_or_weights + diversity bonus + variance_covariance_whitening + reconstruction + navigation + all-hold training
frozen_science.selection: minimum cumulative validation 50_50 joint-plus-marginal normalized energy score among registered noncollapsed trained observations
frozen_science.evaluation_and_pass_gate: full inherited cumulative trajectory gate plus selected-checkpoint all-hold positive in six families and no all-hold family below minus 0.02

terminal_rules.pre_execution_source_or_root_mismatch: Do not launch and do not reserve another output root.
terminal_rules.post_reservation_termination: Consumes the sole execution attempt regardless of outcome.
terminal_rules.stop: Closes this exact 50/50 dual-domain mechanism; every written checkpoint remains inaccessible.
terminal_rules.pass: Establishes bounded dual-domain trajectory JEPA feasibility only; checkpoint access and scale require a separate decision and unseen-control evaluation.
